description: Use when a user asks what to buy for a home gym within a budget and space, e.g. "I have $1,000, an 8 ft ceiling and an 8x10 ft corner, what should I get?" or "best cardio machine for $600 in a small room". Returns a starter set chosen only from products whose stored guide data fits the limits: goal strength gives a barbell setup (rack or stand, bench, barbell and plates) or a dumbbell setup (bench and adjustable dumbbells); cardio gives one machine; both gives a strength setup plus a cardio machine. Each item has why_it_fits (from the data), guide_url and buy_url; total sums the guide price ranges; skipped lists items left out and why (for example price not stated in guide); budget_needed says what a full set starts at. Show buy_url to users exactly as given. Add folds_away=true for a set that folds away, or wall_mount=false for renters who cannot drill. Pass quiet, apartment, user_weight_lbs or min_capacity_lbs to fit noise, apartment and weight limits.

apartment.description: true builds a dumbbell-based set (the Strong Saga $500 guide advises this for a spare room or apartment), skips gear a guide says to skip in an apartment, and keeps cardio a guide names for apartments or calls quiet.

budget.description: Total USD for the whole set, e.g. 1000.

floor_ft.description: Free floor area as width x length in feet, e.g. 8x10.

folds_away.description: true picks only a rack, bench and cardio machine whose guide says they fold or store upright.

min_capacity_lbs.description: Minimum listed rating for the rack or stand, in lb.

quiet.description: true keeps cardio machines a guide calls quiet and drops anything a guide calls loud (such as iron plates).

user_height_in.description: User height in inches, used for treadmill and walking pad ceiling math.

user_weight_lbs.description: User's body weight in lb; the bench and cardio machine must list at least this capacity.

wall_mount.description: false skips anything the guide says mounts to a wall (renters). true keeps only wall-mounted racks.
